measurement_status: no workload launched; candidate release build active
scope: Candidate selection rule; descriptive screening cannot authorize adoption or a statistically qualified effect claim.
statistic: native median of six paired leg ratios per case/metric; allocator median of three paired repeat ratios
stop_conditions: Any invalid/undefined primary or resource metric, custody or semantic validation failure
decision_if_no_stop: Require independent regression review and full six-block confirmation plus relevant fallback controls before adoption.
allocation_calls_or_requested_bytes_alon: Do not qualify as a useful signal.
other_flags: All individual pair/block/phase/tail/RSS/allocator regression flags retained for review; reviewers may reject, never adopt from this screen.
reducer_v3_interpretation: Its followup_required_for_confirmation on defined metrics is a data-admission result, not an automatic instruction to run confirmation. This pre-capture root selection rule determines whether to continue the candidate.
